title: Product: UGC ad
brief: For busy commuters. Feeling: finally a bottle that does not leak. Fact: 24 hours cold. 20 s, 9:16 crop later, one creator talking to camera.

promise.text: One creator, one kitchen, the product always in hand at its real size. No text in shot, captions added in the edit.

looks.Jess: a woman in her mid twenties, fair skin, freckles, auburn hair in a messy bun, oversized grey hoodie, small clip-on microphone

concepts.title: The leak test
concepts.logline: Jess shakes the bottle upside down over her laptop to prove it does not leak.
concepts.hook: A bottle held upside down over a laptop.
concepts.fit: One person, one object, small actions.

concepts.title: Morning routine
concepts.logline: Jess fills it at 7 am and it is still ice cold at midnight.

concepts.title: Gym bag
concepts.logline: Jess pulls three old bottles out of her bag, then the new one.

rows.subject: Jess
rows.subject_motion: holds the bottle upside down over her open laptop
rows.scene: a bright kitchen counter, morning window light
rows.vo: My last bottle killed my laptop.

rows.subject: Jess
rows.subject_motion: shakes the bottle hard, nothing drips
rows.vo: So I tested this one the hard way, upside down. Not a single drop.

rows.subject: the bottle
rows.subject_motion: sweats cold drops on the counter as Jess sets it down
rows.vo: Ice in at seven in the morning. Still ice cold at midnight.

rows.subject: Jess
rows.subject_motion: smiles and points the bottle at the camera
rows.vo: Link is right there. Use code COLD for ten percent off.
